definitions.gloss: bottom futon; mattress futon; futon mattress
definitions.explanation: The futon placed on the floor to sleep on, as opposed to the top futon (comforter) placed over the body. Part of the traditional Japanese bedding set.

examples.japanese: {敷布団|しきぶとん}を{敷|し}いてから{寝|ね}る。
examples.english: I lay out the bottom futon before going to sleep.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}がいいので、{敷布団|しきぶとん}を{干|ほ}した。
examples.english: The weather was nice, so I aired out the futon mattress.

examples.japanese: この{敷布団|しきぶとん}は{厚|あつ}みがあって、{畳|たたみ}の{上|うえ}でも{快適|かいてき}に{眠|ねむ}れる。
examples.english: This futon mattress is thick enough to sleep comfortably on tatami.

notes:
USAGE:
Pairs with {掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん} (top futon/comforter). Together they form a complete Japanese bedding set. Stored in a {押|お}し{入|い}れ (closet) during the day.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敷布団|しきぶとん}を{敷|し}く (to lay out the futon mattress)
- {敷布団|しきぶとん}を{干|ほ}す (to air out the futon mattress)
- {敷布団|しきぶとん}を{畳|たた}む (to fold up the futon mattress)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}: top futon, comforter — the blanket-like futon placed on top
